result.reasoning: This refactor commit moved the `mCurPage = prevPage;` assignment (previously done immediately after popping a page) into the delayed `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal` method, which only runs after the transition animation finishes. This caused mCurPage to remain stale/incorrect while an animation was playing. The fix commit restores setting mCurPage immediately after the page is popped, undoing exactly this change.
